name: Magnum Berhad
overview: 今年 Magnum 的业务板块没有出现扩张、新增或出售业务线的公告，主要动态是完成了一家休眠子公司的成员自愿清盘，以及按季度派发中期股息。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比减少 2.7%，净利润同比增长 8.4%。
overview_en: This year Magnum announced no expansion, new business line or divestment; the main corporate events were the completion of a members' voluntary winding-up of a dormant subsidiary and the declaration of quarterly interim dividends. Latest quarter (30 June 2026) revenue fell 2.7% year-on-year while net profit rose 8.4%.

segments.name: 投资控股及其他
segments.note: 今年完成了一家休眠间接全资子公司的成员自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: Completed the members' voluntary winding-up of a dormant indirect wholly-owned subsidiary this year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 休眠间接全资子公司 MP Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 的成员自愿清盘程序于 2026 年 3 月 31 日完成，并于 2026 年 6 月 30 日解散。
actions.text_en: The members' voluntary winding-up of dormant indirect wholly-owned subsidiary MP Solutions Sdn. Bhd. was completed on 31 March 2026 and the company was dissolved on 30 June 2026.
